text:
maya: quick q — PR #3821 is a tiny refactor (extract helper + rename). can we land in the RC window tonight? ci is green locally but GH shows a lint failure on naming. link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3821

aj: should be fine if it's just renames. pinging @sam for approval.

sam: looked quickly — logic looks identical. i'm +1 for landing but prefer squashed commit. small nit: rename `resp` -> `response` for clarity.

olivia: i'm fine with landing. if GH lint is tripping, can someone run `make fmt` and push? i can do a quick commit if needed.

maya: thanks. i'll run `make fmt` then `git commit --amend --no-edit` and force-push. plan: land at ~22:00 PT unless there are objections.

aj: fine by me. optional: add a tiny changelog line if you think it's worthwhile.

sam: changelog not necessary for this. one more request — please add a one-line doc comment above the new helper describing why it exists.

maya: added a short comment in the latest push and re-ran CI. GH checks: https://github.com/redwood/repo/actions/runs/1234567890 — one flaky test showing: `TestKVCacheEvict` (timing), doesn't look related.

olivia: flake — i'll retry the job.

merge-bot: heads up — RC merge window opens at 22:00 PT. please coordinate merges after 21:50 to avoid collisions.

maya: noted. if checks pass i'll squash + merge at 22:02 PT.

aj: nit — when you squash, please use `git rebase --autosquash` if you have fixup commits.

sam: ack.

olivia: LGTM :thumbsup:

maya: landed at 22:03 PT. commit sha: `abc1234`. thanks folks!

(threads like this: short, one or two quick fixes, coordinated landing in merge window.)
